title: 30 AI Companies Shaping the Future
source_line: Sources: company releases, Bloomberg, TechCrunch, Caixin, exchanges
scope_note: 30 well-known AI-native companies (language, image, video, voice & music, coding, search, robotics), listed by founding year, not ranked. Value = latest completed private round (post-money), market cap for listed companies (close of Nov 3, 2026 unless dated otherwise), or the acquisition price for companies bought by others. Where no recent valuation exists, the card says what the number is (raised / ARR / share sale / pre-money). Flags show headquarters country. Sources for every number are listed below.

insights.text: Hugging Face began as a chatbot app for teenagers before becoming the hub for AI models.
Next: Cohere. Its CEO co-wrote 'Attention Is All You Need', the 2017 Transformer paper.
Midjourney never took outside money. Meta licensed its tech instead (Aug 2025).
Fears over DeepSeek-R1 wiped about $589B off Nvidia's value in one day (Jan 27, 2025).
Google owns DeepMind, SpaceX owns xAI and Cursor, and Nvidia is buying Hugging Face.
